Features
 Dual Function: Light up Xenon White for parking lights or daytime running lights, Light up Amber for turn signal lights.
 High Brightness LED: 72SMD 3014 & 4SMD 3030 chipset.
 Working Voltage: 9-24V (fit 12V, 24V vehicles).
 Output Wattage: 3.5W/bulb (White), 4W(Amber).
 Color: White/Amber.
 Service Life: Up to 30,000 Hours.

NOTICE: For turn signal lights, since LED bulbs have lower wattage comparing with the stock bulbs, you might need to add 50W 6-Ohm load resistors or flash relay to prevent the LED bulbs from hyper flashing, malfunction or trigger warning message on dashboard.
